# Assignment-3_Multi-Screen
## Pre-face:
### Most of the code documentation was generated by AI and proof-read by me for any mistakes and making sure the documentation is proper

## App description:
    The multi-screen app is a simple image display application, where you can create content items with images from URLs, a name and the content description on the first screen. There is a pop-up for successful and unsuccessful creation attempts.
    The Second screen is the content details screen, which display the name of the item, the image, rendered in via the Coil library and its content description. It is only accessible via the third screen.
    The third screen is the list display, clicking on an item sends you to its details page, while a simple red delete button is present on each item to delete it, there is no pop-up to confirm your choice, so be careful ;).
